hard_gate_failures: Gate 6: layout flaws on slides 1, 3, 4 and 5
fixes: slide 1: The NEWS tag sits on top of the watch dial, touching the headline block. Move it to the top of the cover under the header, or into the text block above the headline, so it covers no part of the watch.

slide 3: The photo is a hard-edged rectangle with a smeared grey gradient under it, and the text block sits low. Use a clean full-width photo that fades into black, or a centred crop with even gaps above and below, and put the headline and body at the same height as the other slides.
slide 4: Merge it into slide 2, or shorten it to a headline of 4 words or fewer and one line of body. The '24' block sits high with a large empty space below it, so centre it vertically.

slide 5: The text block sits low and left with a large empty space above it. Fold the buyer's-premium note into slide 3 (it is already there) and drop this slide, or centre the block. Add a second watch photo from the lot to the deck so there is an image at least every other slide.
reason: Every figure matches Phillips' release (US$112.3M, 217 of 217 lots, 24 records, CHF 8,680,500 for the Régence), and the check passes. The layout still needs work: the NEWS tag covers the watch dial on the cover, and slides 3 to 5 are unevenly spaced and repeat each other.
